title: Trump falsely claims ‘nobody’s been killed’ in Iran war ‘in the last five months’
summary_full: In July, three soldiers died in an enemy attack on an air base in Jordan, another died at an air base in Iraq and a Navy captain died during an emergency landing in the Arabian Sea.
